name.zh: 汇报 PPT 与管理层简报

summary.en: Enforces conclusion-first slide headlines and flags monotonous multi-slide bullet skeletons on top of core deck and UI hygiene.
summary.zh: 在演示文稿与界面规范之上，检查非结论式“过程名词”幻灯片标题与连续同骨架纯文字页。

message.en: Topic-label headline names the work done ('Analysis of X') instead of stating the finding.
message.zh: 标题只写了“关于……的分析/汇报”这类过程标签，没有直接亮出本页结论。

deletionTest.en: Replace 'Analysis of X' with the one-sentence answer your audience should remember if they read only the headline.
deletionTest.zh: 如果听众只扫一眼标题，最该记住哪一个结论或变化数字？直接拿那句话当标题。

exemplar.bad: ## 关于三季度新客首周流失率（34% 降至 19%）的分析汇报
exemplar.trap: ## 重塑新客留存增长飞轮
exemplar.good: ## 三季度新客首周流失率从 34% 降至 19%

note.en: Put the 34% -> 19% finding directly in the heading instead of wrapping it in 'Analysis of...'.
note.zh: 去掉“关于……的分析汇报”外壳，直接把“34% 降至 19%”当标题。

hit: ## 关于三季度华东区履约时效的分析汇报 ##
clean: ## Annual Plan Repricing Reduced Q3 Churn from 6.2% to 4.1%
## 华东仓拆单策略上线后次日达占比从 71% 升至 89%

message.en: Four or more consecutive slides repeat the exact same plain text-box skeleton without tables, charts, or visual variation.
message.zh: 连续 4 页及以上幻灯片重复完全相同的纯文字要点骨架（无表格、图表或版式变化），容易引发审阅疲劳。

deletionTest.en: Convert comparative bullet slides into a structured table, timeline, or metric chart to break monotonous pacing.
deletionTest.zh: 把其中对比或趋势类的要点页改成双栏对照表、流程图或数据图表，打破连页同版式。

exemplar.bad: Slides 2–5 all use identical 'Title + 4 plain bullets' boxes with zero tables, charts, or diagrams.
exemplar.trap: Slides 2–5 keep the exact same 4 bullets per slide and add decorative stock icons.
exemplar.good: Slide 3 presents regional latency in a 4-row table and Slide 4 plots weekly error budget burn.

note.en: Match slide structure to the data type instead of pouring every page into the same bullet template.
note.zh: 按信息结构选用表格或趋势图，避免整份 PPT 套同一个纯文字框。
